title: Lejentia 1 & 2 Complete Set Opus Graphics 1987 Indie Fantasy Comic HJ Bennett
descriptionText:
The Lejentia 1 & 2 Complete Set Opus Graphics from 1987 is a rare and highly sought-after indie fantasy comic by HJ Bennett. Set in the Copper Age of US Comics, this series features the character OPUS in a captivating and imaginative fantasy world. With its unique storyline and captivating artwork, this comic set is a must-have for collectors and fans of independent comics from the 1980s.

Complete 2 issue set of Lejentia published by Opus Graphics in 1987.
Includes
Lejentia #1
Lejentia #2
Both issues are bagged and boarded. Covers present well with solid color and no major creases or tears visible. Minor handling wear consistent with age. Overall Very Fine condition. Please review photos for exact condition.
Indie fantasy series with striking cover art. Scarcer than mainstream titles and difficult to find as a matched set.
